description.name: Email Verification Pro
description.tagline: Comprehensive email verification with 2FA and fraud prevention for WHMCS
description.long: Email Verification Pro is a comprehensive email verification module that ensures customers verify their email addresses before accessing their account or completing checkout. Features include email-based Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), automatic account termination, disposable email blocking, IP banning, customizable email templates, and detailed activity logging.
features: Two verification modes: All Pages or Checkout Only
Auto-terminate unverified accounts after X days
Auto-delete unverified accounts with no orders
Lock email changes for unverified users
Customizable email templates with live preview
Sync existing clients to verification system
Works with WHMCS Six and Twenty-One templates
